subject: Re: Redwood pricing & volume qualification — Acme Retail
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acmeretail.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Sophie Chen <sophie.chen@acmeretail.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Nov 2025 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Follow-up: token volumes & target economics

Hey Marissa —

Thanks for the call this morning. Quick recap from our side and a few clarifying questions so we can size this for procurement:

- Estimated monthly tokens: ~150M prompts (mostly text-generation) + 10M embeddings/month for search.
- Current SLA/latency target: p95 latency <= 500ms for gen routes; embeddings can be higher.
- Budget range: we have an annual budget band of $120k–$180k for the inference portion this coming year, but that might flex if unit economics scale favorably.

Questions:
1) Can you share a target $/1M tokens (or blended $/1M) you see for this volume assuming a 12‑mo commit vs pay-as-you-go?
2) How do you price generation vs embeddings vs reranking? Any separate unit rates or bundled discounts?
3) If we step up volumes across the year (e.g., 150M -> 400M by Q4), how would blended rates or tiered discounts apply?

Would appreciate a short note with sample blended scenarios. Also attaching our rough monthly forecast (Acme_estimated_usage.csv).

—Liam
Liam O'Connor
Head of Search & Personalization
Acme Retail

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acmeretail.com>
Cc: Sophie Chen <sophie.chen@acmeretail.com>; Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Nov 2025 16:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up: token volumes & target economics

Hi Liam — great to chat earlier, appreciate the clear forecast. Below is a short post-call recap plus the pricing scenarios you asked for. I've attached our latest pricing sheet and a mutual action plan template.

Post-call recap:
- Usage: ~150M gen tokens / month + ~10M embedding units.
- Key constraints: stay within $120k–$180k annual budget ideally; latency SLO for gen routes.
- Success metrics: cost per 1M tokens (effective) and stable p95 latency.

Pricing scenarios (high-level):
1) Pay-as-you-go (no commit) — list rates: Generation $9.50 / 1M tokens; Embeddings $3.00 / 1M units. Estimated monthly cost @150M gen + 10M embed = ~$1,452 (gen) + $30 (embed) = ~$1,482 -> ~$17.8k/year (note: for heavy usage, committed options yield better unit economics).

2) 12‑month commit (tiered steps) — sample tiers and blended math (illustrative):
- 0–200M: $7.50 / 1M
- 200–500M: $5.75 / 1M
- embeddings flat at $2.25 / 1M with 12mo commit
Blended for starting 150M/month = $7.50 * 150 = $1,125/month -> $13.5k/year (gen) + embeddings $225/yr -> ~$13.7k/year.

3) Expansion path (step-ups) — if you scale: Q1 avg 150M, Q2 250M, Q3 350M, Q4 400M -> we can offer an annual blended rate around $5.50–$6.25 / 1M depending on firm commitments and whether you add new routes/models (e.g., reranking or specialized vision routes have separate profiles).

Notes on blended calculations and add-ons:
- Blended rates assume aggregated monthly volumes applied to tiered pricing; we can produce exact blended $/1M for any forecast you provide.
- Adding new routes/models: if you add a high-cost model (larger context or LLM with higher op-cost), we typically carve out a model-variant surcharge or model-specific rate; alternatively, we can provide a blended rate if you commit a higher annual volume across all models.
- Renewal/expansion: we commonly structure renewal quotes with a baseline committed volume and step‑up thresholds that reduce the effective $/1M as you hit higher bands mid‑term. This avoids re‑signing while giving you lower unit economics as you scale.

Next steps I suggest:
1) Can you confirm whether the 150M is steady-state or a Q1 initial ramp?
2) Share any hard budget constraints (is $120k absolute floor or flexible?) so we can propose a range of committed options.
3) If agreeable, we'll draft a renewal/expansion quote with: baseline commit, Q‑by‑Q stepups, and a blended rate table.

I've attached our pricing sheet and an editable mutual action plan to map procurement steps.

Thanks — copying Vivek (sales engineering) to help with blended math & model-specific notes.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 13 Nov 2025 09:40:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Follow-up: token volumes & target economics — suggested blendeds

Marissa — looping in Dylan and Jonas for quota/finance visibility. Below are suggested quick checks and a sample blended calc we can hand to Acme: 

Quick notes:
- If Acme signs a 12‑month commit at 150M/month baseline with step-ups to 400M by Q4, target blended $/1M we can aim for in negotiation: $5.75–$6.25 (generation inclusive). Embeddings at $1.75–$2.00 given volume.
- If they agree to add 2 new model routes (rerank + personalization) that increase op-cost by ~15%, propose a model surcharge line item OR raise baseline commitment slightly to keep blended under $6.

Sample blended calc (annualized):
- Baseline months (Q1): 150M * 3 = 450M
- Ramp months (Q2–Q4): 250+350+400 = 1,000M
- Annual total gen tokens = 1,450M -> effective $/1M @ target blended $6.00 = $8,700/month -> $104.4k/yr (gen portion)
- Embeddings 10M/month = 120M/yr @ $1.90/1M = $228/yr -> (embeddings are immaterial vs gen in this case)

Ask for approvals:
- Finance: confirm we can offer $5.75 floor blended with the step‑up MRP (mutual action plan) and approximate take rate assumptions.
- Legal: standard SOW with step-up schedule & rollback protections (if they reduce below thresholds mid-term).

Attaching a quick calc tab and the pricing sheet for reference.

—Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: pricing_blended_calc.xlsx (xlsx, 12KB)]

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acmeretail.com>

Cc: Sophie Chen <sophie.chen@acmeretail.com>, Acme Procurement <procurement@acmeretail.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Nov 2025 09:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood pricing & volume qualification — Acme Retail

Thanks Marissa & Vivek — this is helpful. A couple quick confirmations from procurement here: 

- Budget: the $120k number is the lower bound but procurement has flexibility up to $200k if unit economics below $6/1M are achievable and we can keep predictable cost.
- The 150M/month is a Q1 conservative forecast — we expect ramp to the numbers we shared by Q4.

Request: can you produce a short renewal/expansion quote showing:
1) Baseline 12‑month commit at 150M/month with quarterly stepups to 400M by Q4, showing blended $/1M and monthly invoice guidance.
2) Two options for handling new routes/models: (A) model-specific surcharge, (B) fully blended if we commit +10% baseline.
3) Proposed DocuSign timeline (we'd like to finalize commercial terms by Dec 10 to hit Jan 1 start).

If you can send that by EOD Tue (Nov 25), procurement will review and schedule a quick credit/approval call.

Thanks — looking forward.

—Liam
Liam O'Connor
Head of Search & Personalization
Acme Retail
